concerns.text: FR-001 (deploy/manage dynamic scheduler) and FR-002 (instrument nodes for tcpdump/mpstat) lack implementation tasks. T013 (node_manager), T014a (instrumentor_remote), and T015 (scheduler) are marked as missing/rejected in the analyze report, leaving the core orchestration and data acquisition requirements unaddressed.

FR-003 (configurable parameter sweep for network conditions) is unimplemented. T025b (remote_impairment_orchestrator.py) is missing, preventing the injection of latency/packet loss required for US-2 and the controlled impairment scenarios in US-1.

FR-006 (validate against Ong & Motani bounds) and SC-002 lack implementation tasks. T032 (theoretical_bound.py) and T033 (validation.py) are missing, meaning the system cannot calculate capacity limits or flag violations as required.

Constitution Principle VI (Simulation Fidelity) and Plan.md Phase 4 require a DES model validated against physical data. T036 (des_model.py), T037 (calibration.py), and T038 (internal_state_validator.py) are missing, blocking the non-negotiable simulation validation requirement.

FR-005 (output JSON with regression coefficients) requires schema validation. T007 (schema validation framework) is missing, creating a gap in verifying the structural integrity of the RegressionModel output before analysis.

SC-006 (dataset-variable fit logic) depends on T017 (data_collector) to generate the raw data files that T010 (validator) must check. T017 is missing, creating a dependency gap where the validation logic cannot execute.

Plan.md and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) require a defined project structure and linting. T001 (project structure) and T003 (linting config) are missing, violating the requirement to establish the artifact environment.
